transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... I guess work has just been hard lately. I'm a hairstylist, and... I don't know, my hands just feel like they're moving through glue. Even just sectioning hair or mixing color... it takes me forever now. People are starting to notice that I'm just slower than I used to be.
Have you been feeling stressed or overwhelmed at work or in your personal life lately?
I don't know. Work is just work. I guess it's fine. I'm just... tired, maybe.
Do you feel tired all the time?
Yeah, pretty much. Just... always tired. Even when I sleep. It doesn't really go away.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?

Um... yeah. I guess so. It's just... most days I wake up and I just have this... this heavy, flat sadness in my chest. It kind of makes me feel like... like there's no point in trying to build the life I was planning. So... yeah.
Do you find pleasure in activities you used to enjoy, like styling hair or anything else outside of work?

Not really. I used to... I used to like talking to my clients, you know? And helping the new girls at the salon. Sometimes I'd go hiking with my friends on the weekends. But now... I just kind of keep my head down. I try to avoid people. I just... don't really have that spark anymore.
Has something very upsetting or traumatic happened to you recently?
No. Not really. Just... normal stuff, I guess. Nothing big.
Do you feel guilty about anything?

Um... yeah, I guess. I just... I don't know. I feel like I'm just dragging everyone down. Like... maybe I deserve to feel this way, honestly. Because I... I couldn't even manage the basics at the salon. Or keep my money straight. I just... I feel like a burden.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge lately?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think so. I just... mostly just feel like I said. Not really on edge or anything.
Do you still enjoy eating your favorite foods?

Um... not really. I just... haven't really been thinking about food. I guess I've been skipping meals without really meaning to. I'll just realize at night that I only had coffee all day... maybe a few bites of something. My clothes are getting kind of loose, I guess. But... yeah, I just don't really have an appetite.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself?

Um... no. Not really hurting myself. I don't... I don't have a plan or anything. Just... sometimes I think... I don't know. Like maybe it would just be easier if I didn't wake up. Then... no one would have to deal with me anymore. But... no, I wouldn't actually do anything.
How long have you been feeling this heavy, flat sadness?
Um... a while, I guess. I don't really know exactly when it started. But... maybe like a year? Or... a year and two months, probably. It just... it feels like it's been there a long time.
Would you say this heavy, flat sadness is present every day, or are there days when you feel somewhat better?

Um... I guess it's most days. Like... looking back at everything, I've spent most of this whole time just... feeling weighed down. There are some shorter stretches where it's not as bad, I guess. But... mostly it's just heavy.
Would you say your heavy, flat sadness is mild, moderate, or severe most of the time?
Um... I don't know. Moderate, I guess. It's just... always kind of there.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or enjoy doing?

Um... not really. I used to... I don't know. I used to like chatting with my clients, or helping the newer stylists at the salon. And going hiking with friends. But... I don't do that now. I mostly just keep my head down... try to avoid people. I just... I don't have that spark in me anymore, I guess.
Are there any days when you feel a little better and can enjoy things, even if it's just for a short time?
Um... no, not really. Like I said... I just don't have that spark anymore. I don't really enjoy anything... even on the days that aren't as heavy. I just... I keep to myself.
Are there any specific times of the day or week when you feel slightly more interested in things than others?
Um... no. Not really. It's just... the same, mostly. I just try to get through the day.
Have you had at least two months where your symptoms were much better at any point since they started?
Um... no. I don't think so. It's just... been heavy for a while now. I haven't really had a break like that.
Do you find that your sadness or energy levels change at all with the seasons?
Um... I don't know. I haven't really paid attention to that. It just... always feels the same.
Have you had any periods of at least two months without these depressive symptoms since they started?

Um... no. Like I said... looking back, I've spent most of this whole time just feeling depressed and... weighed down. There might be some shorter stretches where the sadness isn't quite as prominent, but... no, not two whole months.
Have you had any periods where you felt completely back to your normal self since your symptoms started?
No, I... I haven't. It's just been the same.
